# CodeRifts + GitHub Copilot MCP

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-copilot-mcp.js from MCP_MANIFEST / CANONICAL_TOOL_NAMES (src/routes/mcp-streamable.js). Do not hand-edit; re-run the generator. -->

Wire the **hosted** CodeRifts MCP server (`https://app.coderifts.com/mcp`) into every Copilot surface from **one**
source of truth (`CANONICAL_TOOL_NAMES` in `src/routes/mcp-streamable.js`).

## Canonical tools (live tools/list)

- `preflight_change_set`
- `verify_receipt`
- `get_decision_details`

Do **not** list hidden/advanced aliases here. Only these 3 tools are the default
agent-facing surface.

## The servers-vs-mcpServers trap

| Surface | Config location | Root key | Auth |
|---------|-----------------|----------|------|
| **VS Code / Copilot Chat** | `.vscode/mcp.json` | **`servers`** | `${input:coderifts_api_key}` + `inputs[]` |
| **Copilot cloud agent + code review** | Repo **Settings → Copilot → MCP servers** (paste JSON) | **`mcpServers`** | Agents secret `COPILOT_MCP_CODERIFTS_API_KEY` in `headers` |
| **Custom agent** (org/enterprise) | Agent profile `.md` YAML frontmatter | **`mcp-servers`** | `${{ secrets.COPILOT_MCP_CODERIFTS_API_KEY }}` |

Cursor / Claude Desktop / Grok use `mcpServers` in their own files — that is a **different**
ecosystem. Do not copy a Cursor config into `.vscode/mcp.json`, and do not paste a VS Code
`servers` document into GitHub repo Settings.

## 1. VS Code / Copilot Chat (developer surface)

1. Get an API key at https://coderifts.com
2. Write the generated file to `.vscode/mcp.json` (or run `coderifts copilot-setup`)
3. Reload VS Code; when prompted, paste the API key for `coderifts_api_key`
4. In Copilot Chat Agent mode, confirm tools: preflight_change_set, verify_receipt, get_decision_details

```json
{
  "$comment": "GENERATED by scripts/generate-copilot-mcp.js from MCP_MANIFEST / CANONICAL_TOOL_NAMES (src/routes/mcp-streamable.js). Do not hand-edit; re-run the generator.",
  "servers": {
    "coderifts": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://app.coderifts.com/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer ${input:coderifts_api_key}"
      }
    }
  },
  "inputs": [
    {
      "type": "promptString",
      "id": "coderifts_api_key",
      "description": "CodeRifts API key (https://coderifts.com) — Authorization Bearer",
      "password": true
    }
  ]
}
```

## 2. Copilot cloud agent (PR / issue governance surface)

1. Repo **Settings → Copilot → MCP servers** (or **Cloud agent → MCP configuration**)
2. Paste the JSON below (root key **`mcpServers`**, includes required `tools` allowlist)
3. Add an Agents secret: name `COPILOT_MCP_CODERIFTS_API_KEY`, value = CodeRifts API key
4. Save. Validate: assign an issue to Copilot → session logs → **Start MCP Servers**

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "coderifts": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://app.coderifts.com/mcp",
      "tools": [
        "preflight_change_set",
        "verify_receipt",
        "get_decision_details"
      ],
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer ${COPILOT_MCP_CODERIFTS_API_KEY}"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Notes:

- Cloud agent does **not** support OAuth remote MCP; Bearer is correct for CodeRifts.
- Cloud agent does **not** support interactive `inputs` — use Agents secrets only.
- `tools` is required; list the 3 canonical tools (or `["*"]` only if you accept every tool the server exposes).

## 3. Custom agent (optional org/enterprise)

Add `mcp-servers` to the agent profile frontmatter (see generated
`copilot-custom-agent-mcp.frontmatter.md`). Tool names may be namespaced as
`coderifts/<tool>` in the profile `tools` list.

## Regenerate / drift-check

```bash
node scripts/generate-copilot-mcp.js
node scripts/generate-copilot-mcp.js --check
coderifts copilot-setup --out .          # write into a repo
coderifts copilot-setup --check          # drift vs embedded
```

Server URL and tool names always come from the live manifest — never hand-edit tool lists.
